notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Weatherlight Compleated, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.
